Step 1: 1100 is a common year (not divisible by 400, but divisible by 100, so not a leap year).  
Step 2: Subtract 140 days from 1100-02-24.  
Step 3: Go back 24 days to 1100-01-31 (since Feb has 28 days in 1100). That’s 24 days subtracted, 116 days left.  
Step 4: Go back through Dec 1100-01-01 to 1100-01-01 is 0 extra days, then into previous year 1099-12-31 etc.  
Actually easier: 1100-02-24 → subtract 24 days → 1100-01-31 → subtract 31 more days → 1099-12-31 → subtract remaining 140 - 24 - 31 = 85 days from 1099-12-31.  
1099 is not leap (not divisible by 4) → Dec 31 back 30 days → Nov 30, back 31 → Oct 31, back 24 days left → 1099-10-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1099-10-07
